newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Hokkaido electricity use hits record high.
newsitem.headline: Japan Hokkaido electricity use hits record high.

text.p: Electricity consumption surged to a record high on Thursday on Japan's northern island of Hokkaido due to chilly weather, Hokkaido Electric Power Co Inc, which services the area, said on Friday.

Electricity consumption amounted to 94.1 million kilowatt hours (kWh), a daily record, after a cold spell compounded by snow made Hokkaido residents turn heating and lighting up while machines to melt snow operated at full tilt, Hokkaido Electric said.
The previous record high was 93.6 million kWh, marked on February 1 this year.
On Thursday, temperatures in Hokkaido's main city of Sapporo dipped to as low as minus eight degrees Celsius. The high was minus 3.3 degrees C, Hokkaido Electric said.
